subject: ArmVirtPkg: Add NULL instance of ArmCcaInitPeiLib
reasons: This commit creates a new NULL stub library (ArmCcaInitPeiLibNull) with new .c and .inf files plus a DSC entry. It is entirely new code addition, not a transformation of existing code.
Coccinelle operates on existing C code patterns; it cannot express the creation of new library stub files.
The change is specific to adding a null fallback for ArmCcaInitPeiLib and has no repeatable match-and-replace structure.
